page.overview:
Who is Adalmann von Hopfberg?

The elderly Adalmann von Hopfberg is the current Sea Lord of the Imperial First Fleet. This position also affords him a position on the Reikland Council as High Lord Admiral.

He spoke Norse and Estalian to varying degrees.

In fact the the First Fleet has run itself without aid or hindrance from von Hopfberg, as the senile old man was committed to the Great Hospice of Frederheim around 2500 IC.
